character.name: Zorvira

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: Hurls a mote of fire at a target within 120 feet, dealing 1d10 fire damage on a hit.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: Fires a beam of crackling energy at a target within 120 feet, dealing 1d10 force damage, with advantage on the attack roll if the target is within 5 feet of you.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: A crackling bolt of lightning arcs from your finger to a target within 60 feet, dealing 1d12 lightning damage. You can maintain concentration to deal 1d12 lightning damage to the target at the start of each of your turns for up to 1 minute.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.description: You gain 5 temporary hit points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these temporary hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage.

traits: Ash-marked: Your skin smolders faintly when agitated, and ash drifts from your fingertips when you cast spells.
Fire-tongued: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, but disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when attempting to be friendly.
Ember Sense: You can detect the presence of open flames within 60 feet, even through solid barriers.
Power Aversion: You have disadvantage on attack rolls with your pact magic when you are frightened.
character.gear: Scorched leather armor · Obsidian dagger · Component pouch · Field rations (3) · Dented brass tinderbox · Ash-scorched grimoire · Healing potion · 50 ft hempen rope
character.story: Born as ash rained from a comet that split the sky the night you entered the world, your mother bound you to a fire spirit to save you from a wasting sickness. Now the spirit’s power smolders in your veins, and you travel the blighted lands seeking answers. You know your mother made the pact without your consent, but the fire’s voice whispers that the truth is far more terrible than a mother’s bargain.

inventory.name: Obsidian Dagger (Pact Weapon)
inventory.lore: This curved obsidian dagger was gifted to your mother by a fire spirit cultist, and passed to you on your 16th birthday, just as the comet ash began to fall.
inventory.description: A sharp, curved obsidian dagger warm to the touch, etched with faint runes that glow when you channel your pact magic.

inventory.name: Scorched Leather Armor
inventory.lore: Scorched black at the edges from your first accidental spell surge, this leather armor has been your only constant since you fled your village.
inventory.description: Soft, ash-stained leather armor, singed at the cuffs and collar from repeated proximity to your uncontrolled magic.

inventory.name: Frayed Component Pouch
inventory.lore: This frayed leather pouch holds the bat guano and sulfur you use for your fire spells, a gift from the village elder who raised you after your mother disappeared.
inventory.description: A small leather pouch filled with spell components, its strap frayed from years of use.

inventory.name: Field Rations (3)
inventory.lore: Dried, ash-spattered meat and hard bread, the only food you could carry when you fled the village after the pact fully activated.
inventory.description: Three portions of dried meat and hard bread, dusted with ash from the blighted lands you travel.

inventory.name: Dented Brass Tinderbox
inventory.lore: A dented brass tinderbox you stole from a dead traveler's pack, its flint still holds a faint ember that never goes out, no matter the wind.
inventory.description: A dented brass tinderbox with a flint that never loses its spark, even in the coldest, wettest conditions.
inventory.effects: Can start a fire in 1 round even in heavy rain or high wind.

inventory.name: Ash-Scorched Grimoire
inventory.lore: This scorched grimoire contains the fire spells your mother transcribed from the fire spirit's teachings, its pages still warm to the touch.
inventory.description: A leather-bound grimoire singed at the edges, filled with handwritten notes on fire magic and the fire spirit's rites.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to fire magic or fire spirits.

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: A ruby-red potion brewed by the village hedgewitch, infused with ash from the comet that marked your birth.
inventory.description: A glowing red potion that fizzes slightly when opened.

inventory.name: 50 ft Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Rope you braided from the hemp that grew in the ash-covered fields outside your village, strong enough to hold even a struggling fire spirit.
inventory.description: A sturdy length of hempen rope, braided tight by your own hands.
